t.zh: 句首、主语后面、谓语后面，都有介词短语。
t.en: Prepositional phrases up front, after the subject and after the verb.

title.zh: Since 2019, the size of language models has grown by a factor of a thousand.
title.en: Since 2019, the size of language models has grown by a factor of a thousand.

body.zh: 主干 the size has grown；Since 2019 和 by a factor of a thousand 都挂在 grown 上（什么时候起、长了多少），of language models 挂在 size 上。自 2019 年以来，语言模型的规模增长了一千倍。
body.en: The skeleton is the size has grown; Since 2019 and by a factor of a thousand hang on grown (since when, by how much), and of language models on size. Language models have grown a thousandfold since 2019.

note.zh: 一个动词可以挂好几个状语，一个名词也可以挂好几个定语。
note.en: A verb can take several adverbials, and a noun several attributives.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把所有修饰成分折起来，挂到它们修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold every modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: 谓语是 has grown。从 2019 年起、增长了多少倍，说的都是什么？
hint.en: The verb is has grown. Since 2019, by how much: what do they tell about?

tasks.sentence: Since 2019, the size of language models has grown by a factor of a thousand.

folds.span: by a factor of a thousand

language models.zh: 主语若是 language models，谓语该是 have grown。has 是单数：增长的是规模。
language models.en: With language models as the subject, the verb would be have grown. has is singular: what has grown is the size.
